text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, I came to the nurse's office to 
have <chrname>'s condition checked, and—

"Ah, yes, hello~! Custo... I mean, 
student, right!"

Injuries? Illness? Or mental care? Well, 
leave it aaall to me with a boom!

Huh? Well, she's in the infirmary, so... A 
somewhat fantastic school nurse? Or 
something like that?

Ahaha, guess you're not that easily 
fooled. I'll just introduce myself 
normally after all.
Ahem! Truth be told, I am none other than—

The savior who guides (probably) countless 
Umamusume! The (self-proclaimed) legendary 
acupuncturist with miraculous hands!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Its name is Sasami Anshinzawa!! Wow, such 
re~lief☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Well, looks like another incredible 
person has shown up.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Wow, you don't look relieved at aaall☆

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"Alright, alright, that's enough of that 
for now. Now that intros are out of the 
way, ready to get jabbed?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"H-Hold on a second! At least give me some 
time to think!"

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! There's no need to be scared, you 
know? I'm just going to poke a little 
pressure point with my secret bamboo 
needle.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
And then, wham... and bam... Anyway, it's 
gonna be insaaanely incredible!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Just so you know, there's nothing 
shady about this! I haven't failed even 
once, after all!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: ...And Master is?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Come on, this is my first job, so broadly 
speaking, I've never failed before!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I spent ten whole years serving tea under 
a legendary master... I mean, training 
under one, so I've got plenty of 
experience.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Wow, what a relieeef☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't possibly agree to an offer like 
this. Taking <chrname> with me, I was about to walk 
out, but—

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: W-Wait, wait, wait, hold on!!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
You're Mejiro Palmer, aren't you?! The 
mood-maker and reliable confidante for 
everyone! The Umamusume who breaks away 
with pure positive energy!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Of course I know! I saw it!! Because I'm a 
fan!!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I came here to cheer you guys on! Believe 
it or not, I came to help out!!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
So pleeeaaase~~!! Give me a chance, will 
ya~~?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... If you insist that much, I suppose 
I could give it a little thought, but...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Please, please, please! I'll even let you 
choose which pressure point to hit!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: There's no waaaay I'll mess up~!!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: ...Probably.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Ah, well, more like practically almost 
definitely? Kind of? ...Whatever, don't 
worry about the details!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, which pressure point 
should we aim for?! Stat boost, health 
boost... Ooh, there's even a charm boost!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...It carries a terrifyingly dangerous 
scent, but there's a slight chance it 
might have an incredible effect... maybe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: What should we do...?
choice_data_list:
Aim for the pressure point that turns her 
into a strong Umamusume.

Aim for the secret pressure point that 
will let you win the race.

I'll aim for the pressure point that 
restores health and vigor!

Aim for the secret pressure point that 
boosts your charm!

I'm feeling anxious, so I'll sit this one 
out.

text_block_list.text:

become a strong Umamusume,' right!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'm gonna jab it in, okay? Ready? 
...Are you reeeeeeeeeally sure about this?

bamboo needles! Reveal thyself, pressure 
points!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Now, relax your muscles~... Wow, 
pain-free☆

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Time for a jab!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: —Ouuuch!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Jab successfully administered!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huh...? What is this!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Incredible power is welling up inside me! 
I feel like I could run all the way to the 
other side of the Earth right now!!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, it succeeded? Seriously!? Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
No waaaay!! How did I even do that~?!?! 
I'm a genius~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
<chrname> was brimming with an unrecognizable, 
incredible surge of power!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems she's seized her potential. I 
felt that we had taken a huge step toward 
our dream...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ugh... that's brutal...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
My body feels so sluggish and heavy... I 
won't be able to run away like this...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: <chrname> was visibly out of sorts...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Ah... Well, you know... right?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: ...Whoa, byebye~☆

Thinking about it seemed pointless, so I 
decided to forget about today's incident."
